theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_pw_pu_span_le_of_inner_det_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (x y : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ x → Orthonormal ℝ y → (∀ w : Fin n → Euclid P, Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (x a) (w b)) = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (y a) (w b))) → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range y) ≤ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
